# Text Editor Vue (@erag/text-editor-vue)

> A modern dependency-free Vue 3 rich text editor (WYSIWYG) built with native browser APIs. Supports TypeScript, mentions (@), merge tags ({{), templates, image uploads, tables, HTML editing, and customizable toolbars.

## Core Information
- **Package**: `@erag/text-editor-vue`
- **Documentation**: https://erag.in/text-editor-vue/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/eramitgupta/text-editor-vue
- **NPM Package**: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@erag/text-editor-vue
- **Author**: Er Amit Gupta (https://erag.in/)
- **License**: MIT
- **Peer Dependencies**: `vue` (^3.3.0)
- **Keywords**: vue, vue3, wysiwyg, rich-text-editor, editor, contenteditable, mentions, merge-tags, html-editor

## Quick Installation
```bash
npm install @erag/text-editor-vue
# or
pnpm add @erag/text-editor-vue
# or
yarn add @erag/text-editor-vue
```

---

## Quick Start (Vue 3 Component)

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { Editor } from '@erag/text-editor-vue'
import '@erag/text-editor-vue/dist/style.css'

const content = ref('<p>Hello from <strong>Text Editor Vue</strong>!</p>')

const editorConfig = {
  height: 400,
  menubar: true,
  toolbar: 'undo redo | formatselect | bold italic underline | alignleft aligncenter alignright | bullist numlist | link image table | code',
  placeholder: 'Start typing your document...',
}
</script>

<template>
  <div class="editor-wrapper">
    <Editor
      v-model="content"
      :init="editorConfig"
    />
  </div>
</template>
```

### Mentions (@) & Merge Tags ({{) Configuration
```typescript
const editorConfig = {
  mentions: {
    trigger: '@',
    items: [
      { id: 1, name: 'Amit Gupta', email: 'amit@erag.in' },
      { id: 2, name: 'Developer Team', email: 'dev@erag.in' },
    ],
  },
  mergeTags: [
    { tag: '{{user.name}}', label: 'User Full Name' },
    { tag: '{{user.email}}', label: 'User Email Address' },
    { tag: '{{company.name}}', label: 'Company Name' },
  ],
  templates: [
    {
      title: 'Welcome Email',
      description: 'Standard onboarding greeting',
      content: '<h2>Welcome {{user.name}}!</h2><p>Thanks for joining us.</p>',
    },
  ],
}
```
